title: Staged readiness validates a merge HEAD against its first parent

outcomes.statement: A commit can pass the readiness commit gate when HEAD is a merge commit, so the first commit after any merge is no longer ungateable.
outcomes.demo: With a two-parent HEAD, check-staged validates the staged tree against the first parent and succeeds, while an unowned staged implementation path is still rejected.

uncertainties.statement: Whether first-parent selection weakens ownership by skipping the merged side branch.
uncertainties.resolution: Side-branch commits were already gated on their own branch; first-parent matches the existing range-gate ancestry rule in linearCommits, so no path escapes ownership.
